notes.title: Patch 0.7.8 - Cultist's Cache
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have finally finished the long-awaited patch and are ready to tell you what will change in version 0.7.8.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/693d0bbf4534575ccacd1d2689aadde59133e5e4.png

As we mentioned in some previous news posts, most of our time was spent on four new scenes with the cultist, which we added to the previous content. The rest of the changes are not as extensive, but are intended to improve certain aspects to make the game more comfortable and enjoyable for you.

So, here is a list of all the changes:

1. In the second chapter on the island, we added the sound of leaves to the scene with Benno.
2. Fixed typos in the text that players sent us.
3. Added 4 new NSFW scenes with cultist Sarah (text, animations) to previous scenes (prison, captain's cabin, corridor with cabins).
4. Improved and detailed the sprite of Exana de Jirde.
5. Improved and detailed the sprites of Beatrice and Montel, Benno's uncle and aunt
6. In Dentwon prison, when the cultist is released, added a background with a missing door to the cell (according to Fab's text, he removes it, but the background did not change)
7. Improved and detailed the sprite of the merchant in Dentwon
8. Added water to the background before the island during the storm - now it appears in the hold, as described in the text
9. In Anna's cabin, reduced the shadow of the gun that Philipp asks to find. Now it doesn't stand out so much from the background
10. In the first chapter after the battle with the smugglers, added a position with closed eyes for the weasel Ordy (when the weasel is lying on the bed).
11. Updated the sprite of the cultist Sarah so that she stands in a 3/4 position like the others.
12. During Tovenaar's story about the history of the world (after the island), instead of the cabin background, we drew 9 sketches illustrating events from the past.
13. In Anna's cabin, we changed the color of the two dildos to a more natural color.
14. We added artwork of Fabian and Olivia kissing during their date before the storm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/f560ad060f21e145936531f75bb5e6251a630bd8.png

15. In Dentwon, the trade window was updated to match the new one in Fortuna's Shop.
16. Fixed a bug where if you completed only one quest for the elders in Podwodje and left, it was impossible to return to the temple.
17. In the trade window, the button to end the trade has been moved to a more logical location, instead of being at the bottom of the screen.
18. In the mini-game “Drinking” with Ka in the tavern, the background for the tutorial window has been updated, replacing the forgotten test version with the current one.
19. During one of the evening hubs, it was possible to help Miss Brown find her hat. The problem was that if you took the quest but didn't find the hat and went to sleep, the quest remained in the diary forever, but it was impossible to complete it. Now it disappears if you haven't completed this mini-quest.
20. Before starting a new game, we added a window for players who don't know how to turn off mini-games in the options, where you can choose to play with or without mini-games. You can still change this in the options.
21. In the Hissara’s quest, during the escape scene through the caves, we added more sounds for atmosphere.

We are smoothly approaching the next story update and want to release it in July. It will be followed by Chapter 5, which we will most likely also split into several parts (at least the main story, side quests, and endings). We really hope to finish the game next summer.

Additionally, we're pleased to announce a special collaboration! We're now working with TinyHat Studios, they are a publishing label who will be helping us out on the marketing side of things. Now we'll be able to spend more time focusing on the game itself!

They're currently running a special discount across their entire label, which includes Wet Sand- you can get the game at a 30% discount right now, with other games on their label also discounted!

Thank you all very much for your interest and support, and may the warm winds carry you forward, wherever you go!

notes.title: Dev Diary #17
notes.content:
Greetings friends, the Likho Games team is here with you and let's tell you how things are going and when the update is coming.

In January we had an unpleasant situation and had to find a new translator. At this time, the work on the story continuation has been suspended, but we have been busy editing the past content.
For example, we added water to the hold during the storm before the island:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/6209d885fd6a30012acb1ac5bdff74c7edf46a6e.jpg
The last patch fixed a lot of issues and improved the NSFW part. Now everything is back to normal and we are continuing, or rather finishing the update work. The team thinks that we overestimated ourselves a bit and expanded the underwater part so much that the next update (the third of four) is similar in size to the whole first chapter. This is very good for the game and for you, but difficult for us. It just so happens that the “competent” division into releases led us to make the first underwater part small and the third one huge. This has taken its toll on the speed of development, but we're getting close to the finale.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/d2ca40bbcdddca9ff7dd3853f92de9e2135e1e5b.jpg

What's in store for you in the upcoming update?

For starters, there are 5 mini-games that are woven into the narrative in the form of mandatory and side quests to gain some arts. There will also be another minor character sprite, a bunch of new backgrounds, 7 NSFW scenes and 3 loyalty quests with the main female characters (Ka, Hissara, Wytta). We're asking for a bit more time, as there were more challenges this time around than before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/2eb1c95e57c5ef2eaa4152f292b7ebcc2242c6ba.png
WIP

The mood in the team is normal, but as it usually happens, the closer we get to release, the more nervous we get. Some things we didn't do as well as we wanted, but we'll definitely fix them in the future. Along the way, the artists are drawing images for the next update and there shouldn't be fewer bugs and difficulties with it. One of the artists is working on old content and we decided to retroactively add 4 NSFW scenes with Sarah as we realized it was necessary. You'll see them somewhere in a patch after the next update.

What's next?

Already at this stage we have received feedback (and we notice it ourselves) that there is a lot of text in the game, but there is much less interactivity, as well as NSFW parts. We will try to fix it, but the main thing is that soon we will start to think how to optimize the story in the last chapter to give only what is necessary, not everything we want. So for now it turns out that after completing the chapter with Podwodje, you'll have loyalty quests available for the rest of the team who haven't had them yet, as well as one mandatory story quest and a finale where you can decide whether to summon the Elders into the world or do something else. Still planning on doing about 15 endings, some of which will be global and some of which will be personal, for each main character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/31a13a04c1ad6ab6e815ca3927fcf865d33904de.jpg
Since we had to put more effort into this update, we wrote and communicated with you less often. We will fix it. In the meantime, we're working hard to polish and finalize the update, which we want to release 100% in March. We hope for the first half of the month. Good luck to everyone and thanks for being with us, because only thanks to your support the game in development is... developing and improving.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.8
notes.content:
Fixed typos in all languages
 Fixed logic bugs
 Added 2 new items (folder with Olivia's documents and poison vial) that were missed earlier
 Animated 20 static frames
 NSFW scenes are cut with precise addition of sounds
 Added ability to name saves as you wish
 Added new missing sounds (sizzling fried chicken, knocking on the door, etc.)
 Optimized code and reduced weight


Hi friends,

We are late with the release of the update, but there are reasons for that, which we wrote about earlier. But to make it up to you, we decided to prepare a patch in the form of a bunch of different fixes and improvements of past content. Let's tell you what's changed:

First of all, the most important change - there are more animations. We animated 20 static images, including both 16+ scenes and regular images, which became more epic. In addition to these animations, we improved and updated ALL 18+ scenes, intelligently adding sounds so that visuals and sounds connect correctly. Initially there was a grand plan to improve NSFW scenes and everything almost worked out, but the catch was that we focused on the example of other games on another engine, but on RenPy it turned out to be more complicated and not so beautiful. But it is what it is!

Among other things, we made a list of 53 edits (!) from typos to logic and from new sounds to adding missing items. Individually, these bugs were of little interest to anyone, but in total, fixing them has significantly transformed the game. We have changed the icons of hearts on the choices in the dialog so that the text correctly displayed and did not cover the number next to it; added the sound of preparing meat when Benno cooks and other rains, slaps, kisses, etc.; finally fixed the error in the logic when finding a folder with documents in the chest - now Fab takes it to himself and the item will appear in the inventory; the same will happen with the vial of poison, which he will take from Ordi; during Tovi's story about the past and artifacts now all items are named correctly (because before they were 1 more and instead of a blade were boots); in several dialogs added sprites, where they were implied, but we missed; fixed a bug where Benno was drawn in the background in old clothes after her quest.

This small update is meant to improve old content, but don't think this is the only thing being done! The main update is in process and is being prepared! Due to some difficulties we're slowing down with it, but overall it's going well. The story sequel will be quite big, there will be mini games and 18+ scenes and personal character quests. We've even started drawing sprites and backgrounds for the last update in Podvodje, so everything is great! We may have something to show you, by the way:

notes.title: Dev Diary #16
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

How are you doing? We're doing okay (not good, but not bad either).

Let's talk about the news that happened recently. There are a lot of them.
Let's start with the sad one: one of the outsourced artists (that drew 18+ scenes) is leaving us for six months, but she drew all the necessary artwork for that time in advance. Also, the translator has found a full time job and will no longer be working with us. This is sad, as we'll have to find a new translator, bring her/him up to speed, and try to somehow match the past type of narration. We're already in the process of looking, but we're afraid we'll delay the update because of this situation. We'll see how it goes.

Well, then, on to the good stuff!

We recently took the time to get together at the bar and discussed a lot of things. Most importantly, we finally defined the scope of the game, the lenght. There was a funny situation when the scriptwriter was sure that version 1.0 was the final version of the game, but the programmer explained that in fact you can make even 2.6 or 5.7 versions. Thanks to this understanding we decided to do this:


 Release two more Podwodje updates and finish chapter 4;


 In chapter 5 we do one big mandatory quest, 7+ personal quests for characters and go to the finale with 12+ endings;


 All this is called version 1.0, but after that we make different edits (about which further on), expand the game with content if needed. Or make DLC.


What's with the “different edits”?

First, we decided to animate not only 18+ scenes, but also 16+ (where there is 1 character, most of the time). After playing a bunch of other games of our type and talking to other developers, we realized that it is worth it. And also decided that we will add 3-5 18+ scenes retroactively, and in the new ones we will emphasize several poses in a row. In terms of text - we also realized that it is too descriptive in these scenes and will dilute it with small conversations and descriptions of sounds. The scriptwriter is mastering video editing and we want to cut scenes so that they become much more weighty.

Secondly, not counting pre-release testing, a tester goes through the game completely every six months and collects the bug file. Not to say that the file gets smaller every time, but in fact there are such amazing things that you think - “How did I not notice it before?”. There are a lot of errors and inconsistencies (just worth the treasure map on the island, which Fabian “left in the books” (no) and goes to the ship to get it, but he has it in his inventory). Everything will be fixed either as patches or attached to the regular updates.

And thirdly, the biggest thing we've agreed on is the Extra section. It's 100% coming, but closer to the finals. What's that? No, well, you probably know what it is, but what it will be for us:


 There will be an EXTRA section in the main menu (instead of Gallery or Help), which will contain subsections


 In the first subsection will be in-game achievements (which are now available only in the Steam version), for which you will receive in-game currency, points. On them you will be able to open extras - in other sections. We make it so that everything can be opened when you get all the achievements


 In the second subsection will be alternative costumes, hairstyles for the main female characters (only sprites will be changed)


 The third will be music, all promo images (which we draw for Halloween, Christmas, etc.), images not included in the game


 In the fourth will be a gallery (if it will be replaced in the menu)


Tired of reading the text? We're sure you are! But there's not much to show us, except this (it's not the finale):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/3cff392780f0d3d64204491570495ca661d5cbaa.jpg

One last thing: we would like to ask you to leave in the comments your wishes about costumes: for example - vampire, nurse, etc. You can even specify which character. There are only two requests - suggest only the main female characters (not Lou or Werewolf) and that the theme of the costumes is not too much out of the setting (farmer's daughter, not office worker). We've come up with 43 options so far, but you might have some great ideas.

Thanks so much for reading, everyone! All the best to you and we love you!

notes.content:

Merry Christmas to you! May this holiday bring joy, warmth and light into your homes. notes.title: Dev Diary #15
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends!

It's been a long time since we wrote developer diaries, and why? Because we don't sit idle and have no time at all! But the scriptwriter has finished writing the last part of the underwater adventure and now he can do the news again.

Where are we?

Working on part 3. 70% of the images are ready. Text in progress (revisions, minor tweaks, translation). We plan to release it in February-March. It will be as big as the first two parts combined. But before the release of the update we want to release a patch that will fix some errors in the text and logic, add missing images in the gallery, fix the bug with the input of the cheat to open the gallery, add animation of the scene with Aquanite on the beach in the second chapter, add characters on the backgrounds where they are needed and some other minor fixes.

All in all - everything is good and the mood in the team is fighting. We've been spending a lot of time on the game lately and that's a good thing. And since we managed to find another artist, the work is done faster and we can afford to create new content and fix something in the old content at the same time.

General timeline

Of course, things can change due to the fickleness of life, but this is how we see the plan so far:

...

February-March 2025 - Part 3 of the Underwater Adventure

June-July 2025 - Part 4 of the Underwater Adventure.

Chapter 4 is complete.

October-November 2025 - Part 1 of the last chapter.

...

Final game 2026

Yes, streamlined and not very clear, but as it is. We have too many ideas for chapter 5 and if we implement everything, we'll be doing the finale for another five years. We'll have to choose, but we can guarantee a few things:

1. Each main character will have their own loyalty quest (like Benno, Olivia, Lauren).

2. The game will not chase you to the completion of everything and until the final decision will give you the opportunity to freely choose tasks and pirate in no hurry.

3. There will be a separate ending for each main character; a harem ending; multiple global endings.

What about the artwork? What about content?

Part 3 happens to be the most concentrated on Podwodje content. There will be 4-5 mini games, 4-5 18+ scenes, and stuff like that.

We can't show much, because some of the artwork contains serious spoilers (and we want you to feel emotions while playing), and some of it is too racy :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #14
notes.content:
Hello, dear players! We come to you with news.

The development of the next update is already approaching the final stage. At the moment we have finished 90% of the images, the text is already being translated, achievements for steam are being implemented, and plans for further updates are being made.



What awaits you?

So, on average the update will take 2-3 hours to complete and will contain quite a lot of visual content:

 6 new items
 13 new backgrounds
 4 new sprites
 5 full images
 2 animated NSFW scenes
 Several changes to past images and sprites

In this update, you'll progress through the story, start completing the Elders' tasks, meet a few new characters, and solve a quest or two. We've tried to add some cute moments, some funny moments, and some scary moments. We're eager to see how you'll take them! All in all, the update is not small, and the next one will be about the same size before we finish with the underwater world in update 4.

Planning

We are such planners! :) Actually, we try to do everything as planned, but sometimes something interesting comes to mind and we can't refuse to add it to the game. But it's not just about cool features, it's about harmonious gameplay. Here we have an underwater half of the chapter, which we divided into 4 parts. It's good to competently distribute 18+ scenes, mini games and so on, but because of the long development time this thin thread of understanding what and where it should be. So, the first update was short and “introductory”, where there was nothing at all (no choices, no games, no NSFW scenes), the second one will be much bigger, but still without mini games and a couple of 18+ scenes. The third release will be already with all the games and more NSFW scenes, and 4 again not very big and no mini-games. I guess if you play the completed version there won't be any weird feelings, but at the moment we feel it like this - crooked and inconsistent.

The plot, the images, the music

As previously stated, Fabian is growing as a person. Now he finds himself in a place unknown to him with no help from his crew or artifacts. To some extent, we realize that judging by the in-game time, Fab has only been captain for nothing - maybe since a month. But that's still a convention, so don't scold us for the fact that he transforms rather quickly. It's fantasy! :) It won't be long before he realizes what he really is and who he is without his suit. You will have to solve the problems of the sea inhabitants, but also do not forget about your goal - to find artifacts. Although... Fabian will have to face a different point of view on all these gods. Can anything shake his desire to achieve fame and fortune?

The artists have done a fine job. Agree - the underwater world even in reality is enchanting and magical, and with the addition of the artist's imagination it turns into an unimaginable place! We studied a lot of references, read about sea creatures (yes, yes, the development of adventure NSFW game is also a study of the necessary topics), and we got these landscapes:

Also, we've been thinking about animating backgrounds and regular artwork. We will try, and if there will be no problems with the realization, then who knows, maybe we'll animate sprites as well? Or maybe it's better to make a movie right away? Ha-ha!

But what is important, although sometimes underestimated in the task of content perception? Music! Completing the synergy of text and images is the right atmosphere, which is created by music and sound effects. We've written about 5 tunes that should evoke the right feeling and mood for you during the walkthrough. We will be very much waiting for your feedback!

And traditionally a few spoilers:

notes.title: Dev Diary #13
notes.content:

Back to you with the developer diaries and want to share information on the Wet Sand project.

So, as has been said many times before, we decided to break chapter 4 into several parts so you don't have to wait years for a new update. There are now 8 parts designated, the first of which has been released. The 0.6.4 update turned out to be a small one, but that's the way we planned it. Consider it an introduction to the underwater part of the adventure.

What is waiting for you next? There will be 3 more updates of the underwater part, and after them 4 more in the familiar atmosphere of a pirate ship for you, drunken sailors. We will try to prepare the next update by mid-October, and it will be several times bigger than the previous one.

What are we doing?

Work! The important stage is now underway - the text is already written, it's being smoothly added to the game, there are some discussions on clarifications/scenes, and the artist is finalizing sketches of all the work for the chapter, to then work on them together with the outsourcer as if on an assembly line.

notes.title: Update 0.6.4

notes.title: Dev Diary #12
notes.content:
Greetings, our dear pirates!

We are hard at work on chapter four and continue to keep our developer diaries to share information about the game with you. Let's go?

Plans have changed

With the release of chapter three, interest and attention to the project has grown by leaps and bounds and we've had to revise some plans for future content. Initially we planned to send Fabian under water for a couple of hours, then provide a couple more side quests for the team members, then come to the last chapter and prepare two endings. Things are different now.

We've heard quite a few different opinions from you, dear players, and decided to expand the story. There will still be 5 chapters, but the size has changed. We have started to develop the fourth part of the adventure (we remind you that the division into chapters - conditional) with the idea that it should be not less, and even more several times than the third chapter. We should also realize that the deadlines will be shifted. We realize that it is extremely boring to wait 7-8 months for some content, so we will release the fourth chapter in parts. So far we plan to make updates every 3 months.

Where do we dive?

The fourth chapter will start with an underwater journey, which will be a separate location with its own story and quests. According to our estimates, the underwater part should be a bit smaller than the third chapter, but how it will be in the final is a question.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/caf4003472c86226740ede719a3437d3891f6837.jpg

We will offer you to find yourself in an ancient sunken city, where Fabian will have to solve many tasks and face mortal danger for the first time in his unlucky life. You will be waiting for the main tasks with new items, characters and mini-games, as well as side quests, the reward for which will be NSFW scenes or gold (which will be soon where to spend)!

Map and characters

Underwater City will be a separate location. Remember the island and the map? Here will be something similar, only bigger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/9bc7f749777bf036764b02b2b348ecbc103bdaf9.jpg

What's after?

After the underwater part you will be waiting for the continuation of the main story and a lot of side quests, such as tasks of the other team members, more content on the world map (we made it large for a reason), more freedom.

We want to make sure that when you get to the last chapter, you enjoy the world enough and choose your path clearly. There will be more than two endings..... a lot more!

Thank you for your interest and attention! We appreciate and love you very much! If you have questions and suggestions, want to report bugs or express your gratitude - write wherever you want. We will answer everywhere!

notes.title: DEV DIARY #11
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We'd like to say at once - this is the last diary for chapter 3! Yes, we're at the finish line, but there are some problems. Let's talk about them.

Animations

If you've read past diaries, you'll remember how worried we were that there would be problems with animations. Firstly, we had never done them before, and secondly, back at the beginning of development, we focused on another project that had animations, and decided for ourselves that it was an indicator of quality and high skill that we didn't possess.

But it turned out to be quite simple. And after all the animations for chapter 3 were inserted, it was decided to update the NSFW scenes from the first and second parts. And that's where the problems happened. Before, there were just static images in NSFW scenes and we could afford to draw 5-8 different frames. Along with that we wrote text for the scene and everything was more or less harmonious. Animations turned out to be more expensive and that's why we limited ourselves to 4-5 loops. Here came the question - how to be if the text describes something that is not in the animation? Gather the necessary footage and animate it now and increase the development time of the chapter because of it (we didn't count on that), or postpone, release the chapter only with animations in the last part, and finish the past ones in the hotfix later?

We also thought about animating not only NSFW scenes, but also some ordinary ones. We tried it on the example of water in this frame:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/df96f37a063e426c364c196618a43fbfb3aab1a4.jpg

But it didn't work out very well, and it was hard to come to an agreement in the team about which shots should be animated and which should not. So this idea is on hold for later.

Deadlines and tests

We're big fans of computer games ourselves and, just like you, sometimes waited for releases that were constantly delayed. Then, being players, we were very angry with the developers and didn't understand why they delayed games. Now everything is clear to us :)

We formed the roadmap as soon as the first chapter was released, giving ourselves 6 months for each new chapter. Things change during the development process. Our appetite has increased and now the third chapter is almost twice the size of the first chapter! We're still targeting a February release, but we admit that polishing can take longer. This is primarily so that you don't have a negative experience during the walkthrough and we don't have to go back with tons of fixes.

There are different situations during tests. Sometimes, only a couple questions come up after passing (and that's stylistic), and sometimes there are more than a hundred of them and the programmer starts looking for reasons not to fix them :) Especially many disputes are related to artistic vision - music, blackouts, sounds, time of objects' appearance, etc.

Here's an example - we went through five iterations of this table for one of the mini games, even though it's not such an important part of the game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/db0ca883baa5a1d239f7942cadc9e8d3578d2b93.jpg

New stage

We (and you too, probably) have noticed that with each chapter the game becomes more and more complex and qualitative. It's normal, because we also learn in the process and can afford more and more new features. We've already cited the development time of the chapters, where the first part we did a year and a half and it turned out to be 2 hours, and the third chapter we do half a year and it is two or three times longer. The quantity and quality of images has increased. Look at how, for example, the marvelous backgrounds are brought to the general style:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/c5b1ee810a79bd76718a4e3370fff679e6f417f0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/a850d8ad58999b591f845989439aadc037c72dc0.jpg

If before we looked at other representatives of the genre with awe, not even hoping to reach their level, now we can compare Wet Sand with them in some moments. It seems to us that the addition of animations, expansion of the story, new costumes for characters and the addition of side quests will raise the game one more step up!

Approx list of innovations

- What we can say for sure is that there are 3 new mini-games waiting for you. They won't be as big as Tailwind, but they will be quite interesting too.
- Naturally, as it was already said many times - animated scenes will appear in the game.
- If you believe the tester, the chapter takes about 5-6 hours with a quiet passage.
- You will be waiting for three side quests with three female characters from the team, each for 20-30 minutes.
Here's the background from one of them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/8ff22158cb3ad36e01abbe273ec2a28c13ef99b4.jpg

- There will be a second page in the relationship book ;)
- We listened to your feedback on the second chapter and decided to add the ability to skip the card game Tailwind like other mini games.
- Numbering will be added to the Gallery to make it easier to find unopened scenes.

By the way! The Pirates vs. Ninjas festival was recently held and you, dear players, did a great job supporting our team of corsairs!

Many thanks to everyone who is waiting and supporting Wet Sand! We rarely release updates (but what updates!) and we realize that we can only keep things interesting with news. But we are thinking of releasing chapter 4 in installments so that we can have content every month. We'll see how it goes. In the meantime, we are back in development and will try to do everything at the highest level!

notes.title: Dev Diary #9

A lot has passed since the last developer diary, so we'll try not to miss anything. There will be a lot of text and a lot of images, so let's go!

Let's start with the sad part - we have reduced the number of artists. This happened for a variety of reasons. Now we are coping with fewer workers. We assure you that this situation will not affect the timing or quality of images in the game, because most of them are already ready.

And then there's the good stuff!


Have you ever been worried about not getting things done in time? We sometimes feel like we're behind schedule, but if you look at the time spent on the previous chapters, everything falls into place. Chapter 3 is being done quickly, despite the larger volume.

Even the tests have already started! Yes, preliminary, but the text is already "felt". The story turned out to be interesting and even multifaceted. It is expected that with full coverage of all the content (we remind you that there will be optional tasks in the chapter) the passage will take you about 6 hours of quite intense story!

Since the game is in development, we are changing some things from past chapters. One of the edits will be a simplification in the gallery - the titles will change to a numbers. This way it will be easier to understand what is not yet open and ask questions to us or other players.

Maps

notes.title: DEV DIARY #8
notes.content:
Good day, dear friends!

Today we will share progress and thoughts about chapter 3, as well as talk about third-party quests.

First and most importantly, we want to make chapter 3 the most stable of all: to go through the problems thoroughly, fix all the bugs of the past parts and polish this one; add everything we wanted to the previous chapters (emotions in the right places, sounds where we forgot, etc.). Since this will be the middle of the game, we wanted to reach a certain "plateau" so that we don't go back and devote all the time to adding new content. We really hope that this desire will not lead to a delayed release date, but we are all human, so anything can happen.

In this chapter, as we mentioned, there will be a few new characters. Fabian and crew will try to solve the issue with that shark pirate, will definitely visit a new town, get into some more trouble and the power of artifacts will start to affect the captain. In this update we decided to add side quests.

Side quests

What are they? During adventures, sometimes it's time for a "hub". In it, you can move freely around the ship and communicate with the crew. In one of these hubs you will be asked to perform loyalty quests from the crew members.

There will be 3 such quests in chapter 3:

The first one you'll get from Lauren Finn
Remember how warmly she spoke of her sister? Maybe it's time to look for that hottie.

The second will be from Benno
The little girl's been hiding on a pirate ship from her relatives. It seems like it's time to find out exactly what happened there.

The third will come from Ms. Brown
The enigmatic Olivia has gotten herself into a complicated situation with one Exan in the past. With those documents, it's about time something was resolved!

By completing their quests, you'll get:
- A fairly lengthy story and even more revealing of the characters' personalities;

- New backgrounds and sprites (specific to the quest);

- The ability to improve or worsen your relationship with the heroines;

- With sufficient relationship level, animated NSFW scenes.

We already said that these quests will be optional, but we have no doubt that you will complete them all :)

The same side quests for other characters will be in the next chapters. We thought that such loyalty missions are necessary for all team members, but in this case we will have to spend much more time than if there are only quests from girls. What do you think about it?

By the way, look who's back from chapter one
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/cdc54ff78f1524e5bccdf4ff8da4a7ff2c6bbe66.jpg

How about we release updates more often?

We see other developers release updates to their games. Quite often, especially compared to us. But, unfortunately or fortunately, we chose a slightly different path.

After talking to the team, we considered different options, but we decided to release updates "rarely but a big chunk". The development pipline we have built over the years has become rather clumsy, but it is very stable and allows us to avoid various problems.

We would like to convey such thoughts to you:

- The game is divided into chapters - "conventionally", as there are no chapters in the game itself. We mark the versions of the game in this way. Now version 0.4+ is available and it is the second chapter (and 0.2+ was the first chapter). So the third chapter will be version 0.6+. All intermediate versions we try out within the team and bring to a decent level to show you a solid piece of the story;

- We will release a chapter every 6-7 months. Yes, it's a long wait, but at the end you will not get 20 minutes of new content, but a solid story of 3+ hours (each next chapter so far is bigger than the previous one);

- Your support is incredibly motivating and helps us to expand the world, increase the number of images, add new ideas, and maybe additions in the future (DLC).

Animations

Thanks to your interest and support, dear players, we were able to find an animator who is already working hard on updating old scenes and animating new ones. We are sure you will love the result!

We can't wait to show you how much it improves the game! But that's probably for next time. In the meantime, hold the image that you'll encounter in Chapter 3.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/62a0d814aa18abeffb00081d809beedf4a6c977d.jpg

Once again, thank you very much for your interest in the game and for your support! The project is developing only thanks to you! All the best!

notes.content:

Chapter 3 and the duration

Initially it was planned something about 9 chapters for dozens of hours, but over time we realized that it is better to concentrate the story and execute it qualitatively. Thus, the course is now set for the release of 5 chapters.

In the third one we wanted to add something new, and among other things, this new thing was third-party quests. You won't be forced to go through them, because, roughly speaking, they are "loyalty" tasks with team members, and if you don't like any of them, you can skip this part of the content (but we recommend trying everything). Once again, we'd like to say about the chapter release date - we're targeting January-February 2024, so everything is on the roadmap.

notes.title: New chapter!
notes.content:
Hello to all sea wolves, land rats, high society ladies, constables and everyone else! We are pleased to present you the continuation of Captain Fabian's story aboard a pirate ship.

We would like to thank you, the players, for your interest in the game and suggest you read the news and then try the new chapter sooner rather than later!

What awaits you inside?

Image Gallery

You asked - we listened! There is now a gallery section in the game menu, where you can see open artwork in multiple poses (double click and if the scene was with a change, the next pose will open). There will also be animated images inside! Now it will be possible to control the process of getting scenes, to understand what has been opened and what is not yet. Each scene has an original name for easy search.

10+ new backgrounds

The story continues and you will find yourself in brand new locations (of course, not counting our "base" in the form of a ship.... although there will be something new in it too). We tried to hide the location of the second chapter throughout the previous news. I wonder if we succeeded?

25 new full art and 18+ art

The chapter turned out to be bigger than the first and the number of both 18+ and regular artwork has increased. There are now a lot more horny moments in the game (and more to come!)

5 minigames and puzzles, as well as new game elements

We could have kept the mini-games from the first chapter, but we thought that would be too boring, so we made something completely different for you! We tried to tie the gameplay of the minigames to the story and logic of the game, so try it out and see how we did it.

2 to 3 times more text and content than chapter 1

This wasn't originally planned, but a flight of fancy and a desire to add as much interesting stuff as possible did the trick. The second chapter has twice as much text as the first chapter. As we have already written, it doesn't mean that we tried to stretch the gameplay in this way - there are more artworks and different situations!

New mystery characters to interact with

In the past we've had little contact with anyone other than the crew, so we need to make up for lost time! You will meet other creatures on your journey to treasure and glory!

New Music

Background music is meant to emphasize and direct the mood of the scene, and since you'll have to go to new places, the music will be new!

Sprite Update

We have expanded the number of emotions for the characters, redesigned Ms. Brown and our elf prisoner. You will also see visual changes in the appearance of the rest of the girls ;)

Easter eggs

We are big fans of movie-book-game geek culture and have scattered for you various references to our favorite (and probably you too!) movies, TV series, games and books. Try to find them all!

Achievements

The volume of the story is growing and with it new achievements. As we said in previous developer diaries, some of them will be compulsory - to record progress, some of them will be tied to relationships with characters (friendship and romance), and some of them will be not so easy to get....

Some bugs were reported from players, but the difficulty was that we couldn't reproduce these bugs on any device. Still, we made a lot of efforts and fixed the bugs of the inventory crash, fixed a couple of logic bugs and we hope that you will continue to point out the bugs so that we can fix them together and the final result will be a quality game!

We recommend to start a new game to study all the content - it will allow you to remember what was in the beginning, build relationships with characters and avoid possible bugs.

We are still working and trying to stick to the roadmap, but after the release we will have to think about the size of the third chapter and the term may increase in proportion to the new content (or stay the same, but the chapter size will decrease). We really need feedback from you - the players. Please leave feedback, write what you liked and what you didn't like. There are three more chapters to go and maybe your suggestion or criticism will make the game much better! Have a tailwind and enjoy the game!

During the development, we realized that not only would we, the developers, get bored with the long project, but the players would get bored waiting 10 years :) Naturally, it was necessary to decide what to do.

We are a small indie team and don't have big financial resources to expand the staff, which meant that there was only one way out - to mercilessly cut the content. We got together, discussed ideas and came to the conclusion that the game would have 5 chapters and that was it.

Now, one year and 9 months had passed since the start of development. The first chapter was hard because it was the first experience, but now everything is going faster. See for yourself, the second chapter is already half the time, and it's twice the size! Magic? No - experience and optimization.

notes.title: DEV DIARY #4
notes.content:
Hi all, we sailed into port and brought you information about the game!
Let's start the countdown - the content is already in the game and testing will start soon!

In this developer's diary we'd like to share with you a nice present from our artist, show some more images, tell what changes have happened during the month and warm up the interest to the game a bit.

Let's begin

To start with, we would like to say that you, our dear players, make us happy by supporting us by buying the game! We are incredibly inspired that the project is interesting and evokes your emotions. This allows us to think bigger and more imaginative, to add more and more diverse content to the game!

The story evolves, and who knows what we'll encounter on the path of dashing piracy?

We burn and live the project, and our artist decided to please the team with a nice gift related to the game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/8b8952f6ce288999674a1efe27926cd217f9bc1d.jpg
These are stickers and prints of images from the game on cardboard. You know, it's an incredible feeling when something from your fantasy takes on a tangible form!

Content

New items will be added in chapter two.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/c6a1b612744b870467e09ae08337d6292c76cd76.png
What do you think it is? A clock and a bag? Well yes... but they are special ;)

We really want to show how much the image changes from the idea to the final version! It might be silly, but we feel warm when we see our first sketches, even if they don't compare to what you see in the game :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/da18a96fc3a19360fb35e81752ba0dfd079872df.png

We're also continuing to correct the faces of the characters, correcting some of the things that don't seem very appealing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/8a58303e0f1441bf09f1f40b44a0e423292dbf32.jpg

Achievements

Not to boast, but we've already prepared the achievements for chapter two! It was decided that each chapter would add a certain number of new achievements. We know that many players like to get them, but here it is important not to get carried away - only those achievements that are really hard to get are valuable. We decided to stick to a simple principle. There should be:

- Achievements for progress fixing (you get them necessarily, after completing a certain part of the chapter);
- achievements for 18+ scenes (it's clear why);
- "moral" achievements, which are obtained by making important decisions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/ccef7686d6ad9f84bca83eeedf4326d091dc504a.png

Starting a new game?

We are curious to know how you feel about starting the game over with every update? Most of us don't like this approach, but the game is still in development and we can go back and change things.

For example, it was only during the development of the second chapter that we realized that the game lacked animation in the racy scenes. We tried to add it - it worked! But here's the trouble, the first chapter also has a scene for potential animation. So that it doesn't look weird, we can go back and redo the scene, add vulgar and lewd sounds (finally) and things like that.

There are times when mistakes pop up even after careful testing. Textual ones are easy to fix, but what to do if at the moment of an important choice the game didn't remember your decision? Unfortunately, in this case we have to correct the misunderstanding and ask you to pass again. It's sad, but we're all human.

But there is a good side to it all! We are trying to follow the roadmap and if you pay attention to the roadmap, you will see that chapters are published every 6 months. That's probably plenty of time to forget what happened in the previous chapter. Also, the logic and atmosphere will be more coherent if you go through the chapters in a row without such a long break.

Please tell us what you think of this!

Internal kitchen and numbers

The mood in the team is good, no one is skimping, everyone is doing their job. So far, everything is on schedule, some small changes to the Steam page, preparing pictures for advertising, thinking over the third chapter are planned at the same time. Every week we share what we've done with each other, give each other feedback, praise and criticism, and then set goals for the next week and so on.

We listened to players who would be interested in seeing development progress in the form of percentages. It's a pretty convenient type of communication for you.

Anna thanks you for your support of the game!

That's all for now.

The whole team thanks you along with Anna! Your interest in the game is priceless, as well as your feedback and comments! Thank you so much for being with us! Next time we'll be in port in June and bring you even more news! Anchor up!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here we are again and we want to share information about the progress of chapter two!
In this developer diary we want to share figures and concrete facts about the development process, as well as show you some sketches, so you have an idea of what can be expected in chapter two.

For starters, how much more new stuff is coming in chapter two:

- 12 new backgrounds
- 7 new full-fledged art
- 15 NSFW art
- Lots of text and engaging dialogue
- 15+ new achievements
- 3 new minigames

That's a lot, isn't it? Don't worry, we've planned it so we'll make it in time for the deadline (summer 2023).

And now for more details

When the game was first planned, we understood that the pirate setting implies adventure, and adventure implies movement, and quite active! The second chapter features completely new locations, not unlike those in the first part. Fabian and his crew will encounter something bigger than a smuggler's ship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/3be2cce6dd40e7c1271bf1c3ecead703804f276f.jpg
We'll visit the "past" a little bit and, of course, see other locations in this world.

It's hard to judge how big the new chapter will be, but it's definitely more text than the first chapter (and the fact that we've increased the number of artists might hint that there will be more images, too). We should clarify that the division into chapters is more our convention at the time of development, the game itself will be seamless. Although, the game will give signs that you've passed some important stage and moved on to the next one.

As for the NSFW images, we've found a way to improve on what was drawn in the first chapter and make the new art more juicy and exhilarating. It's been a long and difficult process, but we're proud of the result and look forward to hearing your reactions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/7e7060434d41846ad1fb93c6078373f4a18c3f5d.jpg

How is the development going?

It's going great! Really. We've reconfigured a bit within the team to streamline processes and get things running smoothly (thanks to the experience of developing the first chapter!).

Always the biggest part of the time is spent polishing - endless tests of the game (so you meet fewer bugs), correcting images, tweaking text in several languages, checking the game logic, preparing announcements and news texts for the release, and so on and so forth. That's why it's hard to give a specific release date.

notes.title: Gallery, Discount, New character, and Something Else
notes.content:
First, we want to thank everyone who purchased our game. You guys are great!

Thanks to your interest, we aim to finish as soon as possible the second chapter, which by the duration will be no less than the first, and the number of arts will pleasantly surprise you!

Discount

A month has passed since the launch of Early Access and we decided to launch this discount so that those who have planned to play our game but are limited in funds will also be able to buy it.

Games with a large number of reviews are considered more popular and Steam raises them in its lists. We certainly do not want to use any sorts of cheats, as some unscrupulous publishers. That's why we could really use your help! We would appreciate honesty, so even negative reviews with constructive criticism are welcome.

Now, let's talk about what we're currently working on.

New female character

We're developing a new character. It's going to be a feisty pirate girl that we're going to encounter more than once on our travels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/8d25b56ac080ac26e503c809dc5a1d082cc9fc58.png

This concept art can show how we choose the appearance of the heroine - who will she be? An elven, a ghost, or a shark? Or maybe all at once?

In fact, such choices are not easy, but we’re doing our best!

Some players may think at this point, "why are you adding another female character when even with the current ones there are no full NSFW scenes?" Indeed, we have received feedback that we don't have enough explicit scenes. The whole point is that we don't want the 18+ content in this game to break the logic of the narrative. We try to build relationships with romantic characters gradually, we reveal all the twists and turns of human relationships, and the most delicious things will come a little further. You have to agree, you wouldn't believe it if Fabian slept with every girl on the ship the first time, he got on it. So, just trust that the erotic scenes with characters you've known and longed for will be incredibly delicious and juicy!

New gallery

But the new character is not all that we can please you with. We also listened to the comments of the players and introduced a gallery in the game, so you can enjoy the images that you liked, as well as understand what art has not opened yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/a2fd67754207f08a051083d3e7f04b1ee94edf11.png

What about relationships?

We have a menu where you can see what your relationship level is with team members, but what does it affect? You may have noticed that some of the choices in the dialogs aren't highlighted - you can't click on them. This is exactly the choice for which you haven't scored the right number of points. But how do you know how many you need?

Just like with the gallery, players wrote that they want to understand which choice would lead to an 18+ scene or just a romantic image. We have added an additional icon with the relationship number necessary for this choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/1bdcfbd7962849c3aa73c3a0168d5d71012809f9.png

And when is the update?

We promised to give some specifics, but so far, it's only been a month since release and we can't give a more exact date than summer 2023. Ironically, your support motivates us to add as much stuff to the game as possible, which takes time :)

In order to meet the deadline, we have found two more artists and the work is going on non-stop.

One last thing I'd like to say: besides an exciting story, lots of images and text mini-games, we're developing a really interesting card game, but more on that later! For now, we're offering a discount on the game for those who haven't yet decided to support us with their gold!

Stay tuned, feel free to comment, write feedback and ask questions! We really enjoy communicating with the players! Raise Your Sails!
